title: Computational aerodynamic study of a shrouded propeller applied to UAV and MAV stationary flight.
author: Guilherme dos Santos Macędo
abstract: This work was developed at the Aerodynamic and Propulsion Laboratory of the École Nationale Supérieure de l'Aéronautique et de l'Espace, located in the city of Toulouse, France, from January to July 2006. Small aircrafts without a pilot onboard, also called UAV (unmanned aerial vehicle) or MAV (micro UAV) have great applicability in the civil as well as in the military fields. This work makes a study of a shrouded propeller engine, used for these kinds of aircrafts in a stationary flight and vertical take off and landing. The study was made in a computational environment using CFD tools for rotating machines. Some parameters and the operating point were changed to analyze their effects on the engine performance.
